branch: Each agent has at least four low goods that pair above its favorite with every shared high good.
domain: strictly positive reals normalized per row
interpretation: UNSAT proves the target anchored family contains an EFX allocation throughout this common-three subbranch. SAT is only a counterexample to that target family, not to EFX existence.
symmetry: common-favorite row lex and unused-good column lex
target_family: All anchor-separated partitions of shape 3+2+2+2 with one anchor from {0,1,2,3} in each bundle.
